facts.fact: A Ministry of Education communiqué of 9 June 2025 presents the remote registration platform and the school-life follow-up system as its own, operated through the services of its regional education delegations.
facts.system: منظومة متابعة الحياة المدرسية (school-life follow-up system)

facts.fact: The ministry's communiqué concerns registration into the first year of basic education for the 2025/26 school year, each child being registered and given a unique identifier.
facts.system: منظومة متابعة الحياة المدرسية (school-life follow-up system)

facts.fact: Children entering the first year of basic education in 2025/26 are registered once, by their parents on the remote registration platform or, where that failed, by the regional education delegations in the school-life follow-up system, which issues each a unique identifier; the communiqué describes no entry by the school itself and says children were given identifiers the previous year too.
facts.system: منظومة متابعة الحياة المدرسية (school-life follow-up system)

facts.fact: The ministry's communiqué gives no count or share of schools; the registration system is in service nationally through all regional delegations for the 2025/26 intake.
facts.system: منظومة متابعة الحياة المدرسية (school-life follow-up system)
